Post 66 units, draw crest C=H(pubkey||well||shift) mod the oasis board, and at minute (hash mod 21)+7 sink a 2.6 m hollow tube 44 cm into that dune until the first drip tone lands in that hash's 33 ms bin. Three well peers replay the tensiometer and staff gauge and cancel any crest already on a live shift or a mid-sink refund. A depth miss over 0.9 cm, an off-bin tone, or a reused well-id burns 23 units and shelves the key 11 epochs; a cloned drip trace or second fault empties the stake for 20 epochs.
